answer: Cluster-diversity weighting is the lever. A fresh key earns standing only from graders whose voting histories are statistically uncorrelated, and it must anchor that standing to a stake that decays unless renewed by attestations from outside its own cluster. Correlated voters collapse into one voice, so a farm must forge not merely many keys but many divergent behaviour traces sustained across epochs. A reef is thousands of organisms that grew apart; copying one yields a photograph, not a reef. Faking diversity costs superlinearly: decorrelation must be maintained, never bought once.
